描述_EN: fragment of canvas adorned with two narrow parallel bands of monochrome wine-red tapestry. it could be a fragment of a tunic sleeve. The two bands are similarly decorated: a fine border of unbleached dots runs along the edges and a fine network of interlacing traced with a flying shuttle unfolds in the center.
描述_ZN: 帆布碎片上装饰着两条狭长的平行的单色酒红色织锦带。 可能是一个外衣袖子的碎片。 两条带子的装饰也很相似：一条由未漂白的小点组成的精细边框沿着边缘运行，中间展开了一个由飞梭描画的精细交错网络。
时期: 埃及 罗马统治时期；拜占庭统治时期
